title: add-rag-agent-tool-calling-quickstarts-docs-update
author: Anjali Menon
body: This PR adds a set of RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and quickstarts to the redwood-examples repo and updates the docs site navigation and examples catalog. Motivation: customers and internal teams want canonical, supported starter kits for combining retrieval-augmented generation with tool calling (search, SQL query, and external API invocation). This bundle includes: 1) three opinionated RAG agent templates (search-first, hybrid-retrieval, and vector-only) with recommended prompt wiring and caching knobs; 2) tool-calling adapters for Search API, SQL-runner, and a demo weather API; 3) interactive quickstarts (TS + Python) that can be run locally or in the web playground; 4) docs site updates (nav entries, example pages, code snippets) and a short tutorial walk-through. Checklist: - [x] Add RAG agent templates and YAML metadata - [x] Implement tool adapters and client helpers - [x] Add quickstart notebooks and CLI examples - [x] Docs site pages, sidebar, and code snippets - [x] Unit tests for adapter helpers - [x] E2E smoke test for quickstart runner (CI) Related: ENG-3142 (RAG quickstarts), ENG-3201 (tool-calling examples), SUP-712 (customer support request for RAG starter kits). Design notes: templates are intentionally small and opinionated - they show recommended batching/cache settings, kernel hints (for long docs), and fallback strategies when tools fail. Tool adapters expose a consistent interface: call_tool(name, input) returns a normalized result object with metadata to allow deterministic logging and evaluation. Quickstarts include both a minimal path (3 commands) and an extended path (integration with a local sqlite store and optional vector index). Docs changes: added /examples/rag-agents, updated /getting-started/tool-calling, and added a new quickstart page with embedded runnable snippets. Implementation summary (commits listed below) and files changed are small, focused edits to examples/*, docs/site/content/*, and a new package examples/rag-agent-templates. CI: added an e2e job rag-quickstart-smoke that runs the TS quickstart in headless mode against a mocked Search+Weather service; job is green in this PR but flaky timeout was observed in one rerun (addressed by increasing timeouts in the smoke test). Please review the quickstart README for clarity and the tool adapter interfaces for ergonomics.
commits: Add search and SQL tool adapters with unit tests
Add TS & Python quickstarts + README and license headers
Docs: add examples/rag-agents page and sidebar entry
CI: add rag-quickstart-smoke workflow and test mocks
Fix: increase CI timeout for smoke test and small doc nits
review_comments: Eve Chen: Nice work - can we make the search adapter pluggable for our hosted search and open-source vector stores? (answered: adapter factory added in commit 3)
Michael Park: Please add a short note about security considerations for allowing tool-calling from untrusted prompts. (added to docs page)
Samir Gupta: CI flaked once due to timeout; please ensure the smoke test is robust. (timeout increased, added retry)
release_notes: Added RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts (TS + Python). Docs site updated with new examples and a tutorial. Includes tool adapters for Search, SQL, and Weather demo.
notes: This PR was intentionally kept small and example-focused to allow iterative follow-ups: we will add additional adapters (s3, calendar) and a TypeScript playground integration in follow-up PRs.
